senses.gloss: उपाञ्च् (उप-√ अञ्च्) P. -अचति, to draw up (e.g. water), ŚBr. xiii.

उपाञ्ज् (उप-√ अञ्ज्) P. -अनक्ति, to smear or anoint (with butter), grease (e.g. a wheel), TS. ii, 6, 3, 4;
 iii.
उपाञ्जन n. the act of anointing, smearing, KātyŚr.
besmearing (the ground with cow-dung &c. for purification), Mn. v, 105, &c.
